places.about: Quest givers and enders ([uiMap, x, y, spawns when more than one], from the guides first, else an unambiguous spawn; or {instance: Map id}), dungeon entrances by instance Map id (Polestar data/codex, each with its source), keys and attunements, the nearest flight path of each side on an entrance's map.

keys.name: Workshop Key
keys.note: Opens Gnomeregan's back door, the Workshop entrance.

keys.name: The Scarlet Key
keys.note: Opens the doors of the Armory and the Cathedral.

keys.name: Mallet of Zul'Farrak
keys.note: Rings the gong by the sacred pool in Zul'Farrak to call Gahz'rilla; one mallet does it for the group. Qiaga the Keeper (elite) on top of the Altar of Zul in the Hinterlands drops the Sacred Mallet: use it at the altar at the very top of Jintha'Alor and it becomes the Mallet of Zul'Farrak. Both places are full of elites.

keys.name: Shadowforge Key
keys.note: Opens the Shadowforge gates in Blackrock Depths; one key opens them for the group.

keys.name: Prison Cell Key
keys.note: Opens the cells of Blackrock Depths' prison.

keys.name: Drakefire Amulet
keys.note: Everyone entering Onyxia's Lair carries the Drakefire Amulet.

keys.name: Drakefire Amulet
keys.note: Everyone entering Onyxia's Lair carries the Drakefire Amulet.

keys.name: Skeleton Key
keys.note: Opens Scholomance's gate; one key opens it for the group.

keys.name: Skeleton Key
keys.note: Opens Scholomance's gate; one key opens it for the group.

keys.name: Key to the City
keys.note: Opens the Eastwall Gate into Stratholme's Scourge-held districts.

keys.name: Attunement to the Core
keys.note: Lets Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain send you to the Molten Core; without it, walk in through Blackrock Depths.

keys.name: Aqual Quintessence
keys.note: Douses the Molten Core's runes; Majordomo Executus comes out only when every rune is doused. Duke Hydraxis hands it out once Hands of the Enemy is done.

keys.name: Crescent Key
keys.note: Opens the inner doors of Dire Maul's North and West wings.

keys.name: Blackhand's Command
keys.note: Lets you touch the Orb of Command in Upper Blackrock Spire to reach Blackwing Lair; without it, walk in through the spire.

keys.name: The Dread Citadel
keys.note: Everyone entering Naxxramas needs it; which of the three quests you take depends on your standing with the Argent Dawn.

keys.name: Dalaran Sewer Key
keys.note: Opens the gate of the Horde's way into the City of Dalaran; one key opens it for the group. The Alliance walks in through the sewer pipe in Cantrips & Crows.

2970.source: recording: players' in-game recordings (to 2026-11-11; excluded and suspect contributors left out): 15 people (8 established) entered the instance (map 2970) 39 times at Sunken Hollow, at a mean of 21.61,27.65

2994.source: recording: players' in-game recordings (to 2026-11-15; excluded and suspect contributors left out): 7 people entered the instance (map 2994) 15 times, every time from Alcaz Island at 75-76,14; median 75.41,13.94 for the last point within 20 seconds before going in

2998.source: recording: players' in-game recordings (to 2026-11-18, the city gate's extract): 119 people entered the instance (map 2998) at a median of 50.72,61.12 (each entry's point as it went in); the walking maps hold one surface there, at 140

3039.source: recording: players' in-game recordings (to 2026-11-15; excluded and suspect contributors left out): 25 people walked in at a median of 37.52,38.17, their last point within 20 seconds before entering the instance (map 3039)

3065.source: recording: players' in-game recordings (to 2026-11-15; excluded and suspect contributors left out): 54 people walked in at a median of 28.26,47.64, their last point within 20 seconds before entering the instance (map 3065)

trips.about: A dungeon trip's quests and travel, from Polestar's pick-up and hand-in rules (addon/Polestar/Dungeons/Pickup.lua, Handin.lua) ported to tools/route_reference/trips.mjs: per dungeon (instance Map id) its page of quests and its entrance in world yards [continent, x north, y west]; per quest what the rules read (g: givers, e: enders, each [c, x, y, side bits, npc/object key]; gi/ei: given/taken inside only; obj_s: objectives' seconds); the travel network (flight masters, legs, boats); the uiMap frames [continent, left, right, top, bottom]; and per side the tours with nothing done, standing at the entrance, that wowstats/plan/tripcost.py must replay; a dungeon run in wings has the same page and tours per wing (wings).
